text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy event: rolling out feature flag `ff_secret_toggle` to prod canary group (10% of hosts). Triggered by samir at 2024-12-03T14:33:09Z.

oncall-1: seeing a spike in 5xx from model-routing in canary right after rollout, paging now.

samir: ack, investigating. I pushed a config that flips an env var to point to the new KMS key for secret fetch.

eva: @samir can you paste the exact env change?

samir: here: ```ENV_REDIS_SECRET_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd-rotated``` I toggled the feature flag via the console.

oncall-1: logs show decrypt errors: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd-rotated"

tasha: that looks like missing grant on the canary role. New key probably hasn't been allowed for the service account.

samir: oh — the KMS key policy was updated but I didn't add the infer-service principal for canary nodes. My bad.

oncall-1: impact: 10% of traffic -> 4xx/5xx for calls that require fetching secrets (model credentials). We've got customer error reports for token fetch failing.

eva: paging customer-facing teams: sending quick note to support.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20241203-1145. Severity: P2. Assigned: oncall-1, samir.

oncall-1: mitigation plan: immediately flip feature flag back to previous state (kill-switch) for canary to stop routing to nodes with broken secret fetch. Then we can either patch IAM/KMS or reissue secrets.

samir: rolling back flag now via api... `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"ff_secret_toggle","value":"off","scope":"canary"}'`

deploy-bot: Feature flag change applied: ff_secret_toggle -> OFF (scope: canary).

oncall-1: traffic normalizing. Error rate back to baseline within 30s. :white_check_mark:

tasha: nice. Next: verify no residual requests queued and confirm customer-facing triage.

eva: support message sent to affected orgs indicating transient auth errors during a limited canary. No data loss, retries recommended.

samir: steps to fully resolve: 1) update KMS key policy to grant arn:aws:iam::123:role/inference-canary-runner kms:Decrypt, 2) re-run canary with flag, 3) monitor. I'll open PR for the key policy change.

oncall-1: handoff to eng-infra for KMS policy change. @tasha you're taking postmortem lead?

tasha: yes, I'll own the follow-up and timeline. We should treat this as config-mismatch during rollout.

ops-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall -> eng-infra at 2024-12-03T14:36:40Z. Assigned eng-infra: eva.

eva: will apply key policy change now in staging then prod. ETA 25m. Will coordinate with samir for verification.

samir: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1027 — adds canary role to KMS key policy and documents rollout checklist.

oncall-1: customer-impact summary for postmortem: ~10% of requests for 2.5 minutes experienced secret fetch failures producing 5xx for downstream calls. Affected customers: internal monitoring flagged 6 orgs with elevated errors; support reached out to top 3. No secret exposure.

tasha: timeline note: root cause = feature flag rollout combined with out-of-sync KMS policy (missing canary principal). Contributing factor: no automated check in the flagging system for env-dependent KMS grants.

ops-bot: Updating incident severity -> P3 (reduced) after rollback and mitigation.

eva: policy applied to prod key at 2024-12-03T15:00:12Z.

samir: will re-run canary flip in 30m under watch, with fallback kill-switch ready.

oncall-1: before we re-run, can we add a quick guard in deploy pipeline to verify KMS decrypt on a canary job? Even a single test fetch would catch this.

tasha: agreed — include a smoke-step: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob ...` using canary role creds in the rollout playbook. I'll add to checklist.

samir: re-run scheduled 15:30 UTC. I'll be on pager and will watch metrics.

eva: closing incident channel once postmortem doc is drafted.

tasha: postmortem owners: tasha (lead), samir (author of change), eva (infra verification), oncall-1 (detection/mitigation). Deadline: draft by 2024-12-06.

oncall-1: any other action items?

samir: I'll add automated test and update PR description.

eva: I'll create a dashboard alert for KMS Decrypt AccessDenied spikes during rollouts.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20241203-1145 status: mitigated. Channel will stay open for 2 hours for follow-ups. :hammer:
